newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian industry on growth path - WIFO.
newsitem.headline: Austrian industry on growth path - WIFO.

text.p: Austrian industry is continuing an upturn begun last summer, stoked by rising demand for base products, economic research institute WIFO said on Friday.
WIFO, whose forecasts form the basis of government policy, said the recovery had also filtered through to machining and manufacturing.
"As is usual in the early phases of an upturn, demand is highest in base industry, which is benefiting from stock-building by other sectors," WIFO said in a statement.
"Machining and manufacturing have also seen a significant rise in orders, above all from abroad," it continued, without giving precise figures.
The job market too was showing signs of recovery as some sectors, like technology, started to create new work places.
Industries that were traditionally reliant on domestic markets -- the consumer industry and building materials -- were last to notice the improvement, WIFO added. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
